ruleName: Ball Lost or Out of Bounds: Provisional Ball
group: General Play – Ball Lost or Out of Bounds
title: Procedure When a Ball is Out of Bounds
question: Your ball crosses an out of bounds fence on the 8th hole. You find where it crossed and drop a ball there under one penalty stroke. What is the ruling?

choices.text: Correct only if a Local Rule is in place.
Incorrect under the Rules of Golf.
You must play a provisional ball.

explanation: Under the standard Rules of Golf, if a ball is out of bounds, the player must take stroke and distance relief by playing another ball from where the previous stroke was made, under penalty of one stroke. Dropping a ball at the point it crossed the boundary is not allowed unless a Local Rule specifically permits it.
